venues.parkingDetail: For Balboa Theatre events, we recommend parking at the 225 Building Garage at 225 Broadway Circle. This underground facility offers easy access to the Balboa Theatre entrance and you can avoid the heavy traffic congestion frequently encountered on Fourth Avenue. Event access is after 5:30p Mon - Fri and all day Saturday and Sunday. Enter Broadway Circle from the intersection of 2nd Ave. and Broadway and follow around to the garage entrance down ramp on the left. Advance Parking Passes (valid for 225 Building Garage only) for most Balboa Theatre events may be purchased at the same time as your event tickets…please ask our operators. The Balboa Theatre currently offers discounted rate validations for Horton Plaza Parking, if patrons choose to use their garage facilities. Patrons parking in the Horton Plaza Garage are subject to validation ticket policies and/or standard hourly fees as established by their Management.

events.info: REBELUTION and................... Steel Pulse The Movement Surfer Girl The Gaslamp Killer Joe Samba Doah?s Daydream Cappo Kelley The 5th annual Mission Bayfest returns on October 16-18, 2026, at the scenic Mariners Point Park! Join us for an unforgettable weekend where high energy musical performances meet paradise. Fans can immerse themselves in the festival vibe with over 30 electrifying acts across 3 stages, as San Diegos finest DJs keep the energy alive between sets. Relax and explore the picturesque park with its sand, water, and grassy landscapes, all while enjoying a variety of delicious offerings from local food vendors. Sip on craft beers and cocktails mixed by talented bartenders, and get ready for a music festival experience that feels like a mini-resort escape. This is your chance to be part of an iconic celebration. See you at Mission Bayfest 2026! No refunds rain or shine
